The alloys were prepared by vacuum non-consumable arc melting, the button-shaped alloys were remelted five times to ensure uniformity,
and master alloy rods with 14 mm in diameter were prepared by electrical discharge machining (EDM).

Liquid metal cooling directional solidification was carried out in a high vacuum directional solidification furnace. When the furnace chamber was evacuated to a vacuum level of 1 × 10 −3 Pa, the high purity (99.99 vol%) argon was backfilled into the chamber to minimize the contamination and volatilization. The directional solidification was carried out at 1980 °C and a rate of 500 μm/s.

The first heat treatment was carried out in a high vacuum (< 1.0 × 10 −3 Pa) heat treatment furnace at 1450 °C for 12 h with the heating rate of 12.5 °C/min. Then the samples were cooled down to room temperature in the furnace.

evidence.section: 3.3. Fracture toughness of the alloy after heat treatment
evidence.quote: For the 0.3Y alloy, the fracture toughness increases by 16.7% (27.9 MPa) while the fracture toughness increases by 30.3% (32.7 MPa) for the 0.6Y alloy.

evidence.section: 3.3. Fracture toughness of the alloy after heat treatment
